summary: Enterprise rate limiting and abuse protection are enforced through named policies for auth, password reset, step-up challenge, billing checkout, billing portal, upload, export, GDPR delete, audit-chain verification, webhooks, and general API traffic. Production uses Upstash Redis, high-risk policies fail closed on limiter dependency failure, and development/test are the only in-memory fallback environments.
redactionConfirmation: All secrets, tokens, credentials, connection strings, raw Redis keys, raw IP addresses, raw user-agent values, and access-granting values are redacted from evidence.
controlsVerified: Named policies exist for auth, password-reset, step-up-challenge, billing-checkout, billing-portal, upload, export, gdpr-delete, audit-chain-verify, webhook, general-api, and health-internal.
Production uses Upstash Redis REST pipeline with INCR, EXPIRE NX, and TTL.
Development and test use in-memory buckets only when Upstash is not configured or unavailable.
High-risk production policies fail closed when Redis is missing, unavailable, or returns an invalid response.
General API and health/internal policies use explicit low-risk fail-open behavior.
Limiter keys include route, action, user, organization, hashed IP, and hashed user-agent where useful.
Blocked responses emit Retry-After, RateLimit-Limit, RateLimit-Remaining, and RateLimit-Reset headers.
Blocked requests produce rate_limit_blocked or high_risk_rate_limit_blocked audit events without storing raw limiter keys or raw network identifiers.
Focused tests cover below-limit allow, above-limit block, Redis unavailable high-risk production block, Redis unavailable dev/test non-blocking fallback, and tenant bucket isolation.

runtime.lowRiskProductionFailureMode: explicit policy fail-open for general-api and health-internal
runtime.pipelineResponseParsing: accepts object-style REST result fields and tuple-style result entries

notes: This evidence file follows runtime evidence hygiene and contains no secret values.
Security CI route scanners must continue to block sensitive or high-risk routes that lack rate-limit guard tokens.
